test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) ORK**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fef04411b20b4c024646d0d36488ce937e8cac4e67d89bb4706778202b9ad64.png] 

Option 2) RUO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d17c3c85074b6b4f79f1fd90f20991c50e71214576daab56b3c44d23d7c2a4d5.png] 

Option 3) ILF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e79d0ddc4aced8475117d35237c1976711eaedd71c62e2522789833615a003e.png] 

Option 4) LOI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e917c94126a783a4767396a485924b3b76822719c72703a63ef089516f650194.png] 

Here, 'ORK' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
